title: Correct potential difference
description: Essential: Student must calculate U_AB = E * L * cos(60°) = 100 V.

title: Correct work calculation
description: Essential: Student must calculate W_AB = q * U_AB = 2 J.

title: Proper component selection
description: Important: Student must use the parallel component of displacement (L*cosθ) in the potential difference formula.

title: Correct work-energy relationship
description: Important: Student must apply W = qΔV to relate work to potential difference.

title: Sign interpretation
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns sign to work or potential difference for positive charge movement.

title: Angle misuse
description: Pitfall: Student uses sin(60°) instead of cos(60°) for the parallel displacement component.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student shows unit analysis confirming volts and joules in final answers.
